The issuer shows solid balance-sheet strength and liquidity, with a current ratio of 1.39, equity covering about 47% of assets, and retained earnings nearly matching total equity, which supports financial resilience. Profitability is positive but not exceptionally strong relative to the very large asset base (EBIT of 1,842M on 110,429M of assets), so the profile looks comfortably investment grade but not at the highest tiers.

DECISION: A-
